question: What is the ruling on: feedback is probes two consumer kinds?
why_it_blocks: answered before the question door existed; migrated into the corpus so the system reads its Q&A in one place
answer:
every feedback was probably a probe reporting in.
we identified 2 kinds of consumers for feedback. Active ones and passive ones. active ones can get feedback, and within their own structure, however that may work, AI or not, the reciever can assess the feedback and act on it. Sending an entire ticket back to design is that kind of feedback, in that design then comes before you and i, who can act on it.
but an inspector is not that kind of animal. it can recieve feedback to a mailbox/data recorder (a tool we specified but i haven't checked to see if it was ticketed or built) that would just record all the feedback until an LLM inspection pass later to evaluate the feedback and see if we needed to alter the questions the inspector is asking.
so for the specific case you described, i'd say it would need an extra probe for each thing it wanted to report back to.
